scope: Review existing uncommitted serialization/shared-pass edits, repair measurement boundaries, independently test split/unified behavior, and apply bounded nearby CPU serialization/cache simplifications. Native HUD/transactional RayScene work remains in the same working tree but is documented separately.
supplied_claims: Not trusted. The +18.2% reciprocal-median FPS, 100% visual equivalence, zero-copy and zero-hot-path-allocation claims are not accepted as demonstrated product results.

supplied_artifact_reinspection.scenario: All have vehicle_preview=false live_flight=false server_flight=false hud=false prestream_s=1 sim_step_s=0; 60 measured frames after 30 warmup. No second mesh pass exists in that native scenario. Build metadata commit is unknown; background jobs remain pending. This cannot demonstrate a terrain+mesh pass-merging benefit or prove identical per-frame streaming work.
supplied_artifact_reinspection.diff_boundary: Pillow-decoded uint8 RGBA; absolute signed-int16 channel differences, changed-pixel mask uses any changed RGBA channel. Not a blind review. The cause of the supplied differences is not established; Early-Z was not isolated.
supplied_artifact_reinspection.existing_test_gap: surface_lighting::fixed_source_shadow_frame_cost calls terrain.encode then mesh.encode; its exact-pixel assertion compares shadow cache versus forced redraw, not the merged pass.

changes.scopes: Five marks now bracket shadows, AS, classification+shared raster, UI. render.rt_as_build and render.scene_classify_and_raster replace historical render.terrain_and_sky/render.mesh_and_rt names. Metadata gpu_scope_layout=unified-scene-v2; no fabricated GPU time, ordinary path still constructs no profiler.
changes.pass_contract: Reuse existing mesh/terrain pipelines, shared targets/device/queue; prepare AS before the render pass. draw_into_pass requires matching format, Depth32Float and single-sample attachments. No-draw mesh sets skip AS work. Split encoders remain the test reference, not a separate renderer or configuration mode.
changes.nearby_shadow_optimization: 12 fixed matrices (Option marks initial unpublished state), 800-byte stack frame only when changed; layer writes borrow its matrix slices. No transient Vec for these CPU serialization steps, but no claim about driver/queue/global hot-path allocations or zero-copy.
changes.nearby_terrain_optimization: One reusable staging Vec pre-sized at admitted terrain slot capacity; 112 retained CPU bytes per slot. Camera-origin changes and partition publication refill it; projection/attitude/exposure-only changes do not reserialize/upload tile anchors. Each frame is encoded as a fixed 112-byte stack record then appended once, not four bytes at a time. All fallible staging finishes before GPU publication; invalid candidates leave live camera/frame state intact.

correctness.unified_oracle: tests/unified_scene.rs exercises actual split/unified APIs B/A/B/A on the same scene at 129 and 256 pixels, visible and empty meshes, transform changes, sky, shadow cache/forced redraw, RT off/on and spectral ocean off/on. Includes a visible foreground and uncovered-sky fixture, not only equality between blank frames.
correctness.terrain_CPU_oracle: Exact pre-optimization inner-Vec encoder comparison over 1024 anchors at ordinary/large origins, staging pointer/capacity reuse and invalid-input recovery.
correctness.origin_cache_oracle: Real-adapter private scratch marker verifies projection/attitude/exposure-only changes do not serialize frames, a changed origin refills the same capacity, and invalid view state is rejected without publication.
correctness.status: First sequential release oracle passed exact pixels, including foreground and uncovered-sky observability assertions, RT/ocean on/off and empty meshes. Origin-cache hardware oracle also passed. Initial new image fixture saturated the direct specular lobe; its material was adjusted to keep the foreground-observability assertion meaningful. No split/unified byte mismatch was observed in that development failure. Final post-packed-encoding rerun is recorded below.

measurement_plan.GPU: cargo test --release -p thessa-render-wgpu --test unified_scene fixed_resident_split_unified_cost -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1; same scene/buffers, 1024 patches, 64 synthetic quads, RT off, 1280x720, static and identical moving-camera paths. First run ABAB; final run ABAB then BABA to counterbalance order drift, with 600 measured frames and 30 warmup in each block. Hardware GPU command and update-through-GPU-completion wall p50/p95/p99; uploads outside GPU interval, readback/streaming/pipeline setup outside both intervals. Not an exact old-executable or production-FPS comparison.

first_ABAB.interpretation: Static paired gains vary greatly; moving includes one small regression and one improvement. Does not substantiate supplied +18.2% game-FPS claim. This run predates fixed-record CPU packing; its GPU interval excludes uploads, but its host numbers belong to that earlier CPU encoder.

scalar_CPU_diagnostic.finding: The supplied scalar append loop was slower in this isolated workload. Fewer allocations alone were not accepted as sufficient justification to retain it.

first_packed_CPU_diagnostic.boundary: Within-run rotated same-workload comparison. Do not compare absolute medians across the separate runs: clocks/cache/host state differ. Exact bytes pinned independently; no allocator-wide or application-speedup claim.

gates_before_final_packing.note: The earlier server-test missing-executable prerequisite was fixed by building thessa-server, and the sequential native run passed. Final packed-encoding gates are recorded below.

final_results.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Linux, Vulkan; radv; Mesa 26.2.4-arch1.1. Sequential agent jobs; GPU/CPU clocks, caches and desktop activity were not locked.

counterbalanced_pass_cost.interpretation: Only a small central GPU-command difference on this synthetic resident workload, with larger block/tail drift. These are medians of four per-path block medians, not pooled frame percentiles or statistically established cross-workload gains. No claim of a stable production/FPS speedup; certainly not evidence for supplied +18.2%. All final-frame RGBA comparisons matched exactly across paths.

CPU_encoding.interpretation: Packed/staged median is about 17.45% below the legacy encoding median within this rotated same-input run; supplied scalar loop is slower. This is CPU serialization only, not frame time/FPS, allocator-wide behavior or zero-copy. Absolute CPU medians drift across runs; both packed diagnostics preserve the same within-run ordering.
